This game has a ridiculous "auto-save" feature where one mistake/death sets you back to the first island. This wouldn't be so bad if you could just revert back to an old save but the developers feel the need to make their game unforgiving (instead of an enjoyable experience for all) and force players to practically start over (with the exception of what you built on the first island).

There are 5 game modes: Peaceful, Easy, Normal, Hard, and Cursed. This unforgiving auto-save feature should be on Hard and Cursed only. Why we can't manually save on Peaceful, Easy, and Normal is beyond me. If I make a mistake, it would be nice to revert back and try again.

The biggest frustration with this are the hermits. As you progress through each new land, you unlock unique hermits that grant you special upgrades to buildings. However, they can be taken by the Greed, and if you don't stop this, you'll lose them. You can't even go back to their island/hut and acquire them again for another cost. They're gone forever. You have to live with it, or start a completely new run.

Developers need to understand not every single gamer wants unforgiving "Ironman" modes with permanent consequences and an auto-save that keeps them from going back. Yes, the option should be there for players who want it, but not all of us want to eat, sleep, and breath Kingdom: New Lands and play over, and over, and over, and over.

Anyway, game is fun at first but there are a few negatives that put me at my thumbs down rating:

1. The auto-save with no manual saves is my biggest gripe, as mentioned above.

2. The games economy is absolutely broken. You can easily acquire gold, especially if you have (just 1-2) farmers. This part needs significant balancing. I'm not wanting to grind for gold for hours on end, but I also don't want mountains of coins pouring out of my villagers and overflowing into the river every 2 seconds, either.

3. The game does get repetitive after a few runs, and each DLC is pretty much cosmetic. Sure, some mounts have unique abilities, and even your monarch gets an ability (in some DLC). However, each DLC is the exact same thing. Build tower and wall, upgrade, defend waves of the same enemies at night, and destroy portals. It would have been nice if each DLC would have added new enemies, objectives, and/or quests.

However, I'm just one thumbs down mixed within thousands of positive reviews. Do keep in mind, though, that each DLC does get more and more negative reviews. Likely due to point #3 above. While you'll probably enjoy the game your first couple of runs, it does get old very quickly and doesn't have high replay value. This could be remedied if the devs would just let us have our own unique manual saves so we can make mistakes, revert back, keep progressing, and just enjoy the game.

And no... the answer is not "Peaceful Mode" only. I do want a slight challenge. Even if the games difficulty was based on one of the five modes, but then you made an additional selection for "Ironman." Just a thought.

Kingdom new lands is probably one of the best games i have ever played. I probably have like 10x more hours than it shows because i've played it on multiple platforms for years by now. Looking back i also think the enjoyment i got from it was mainly due to me playing without ever seeking information or any kind of "help" online. This game DOES NOT require you to research anything and i personally think it will ruin your entire experience if you do. The less you know the better! I'll try to list all the things that make it the best game ever.

-Amazing and underrated soundtrack
Even if you are not going to play this game or may even have disliked it, i think it's worth listening to the entire soundtrack, it's quite relaxing and fits the game perfectly. The wings march, Together, The flats, Meadow, Rest... I don't think there's a single bad song in this game. ToyTree is an amazing musician and it was a pleasure for my ears to listen to his works in this game.

-Coins
The way the coin is picked up. The way the coins are spent. The way it's represented. The sound the coin makes. Respecting the principle of not visually polluting a screen with a number, but instead making something so visually clear and interesting that even someone from an isolated tribe that doesn't even have a written language could understand. A masterclass of game and interface design that every developer should reflect on.

-The way Kingdom: New Lands differ from other games in the series
This is probably the second game in the series and the first i've played. The first game, often referred as "classic", is way too simple and there's only one "island" (i don't think it's even a island) and there's not much content or objectives on that one except surviving. 
The game that came after it, "Two Crowns", is a game where you literally have nothing to lose, as the things get permanently modified by you even after you die. Your descendants (your next attempts) inherit everything you built previously. This goes against the core gameplay that makes New Lands what it is. I got the achievement for doing everything in one run, but it literally doesn't matter, since you just try again from the same spot with most resources. There's no thrill in achieving something without being able to even lose it in that game... Of course it has a lot positive aspects too, but i would like to make it clear that all these games are quite different from one another and this one is still unique and not by any means overshadowed by the most recent ones.

-Difficulty
This is also one of the most frustrating games that i've played, there's nothing quite like failing at this game. It's brutal and unforgiving depending on how much you screw up. No game i've played can replicate the feeling of your crown coming off, it's a heartache, a despair, a unique kind of pain only found here. So there's going to be some challenges along the way, but you will always return a better and more knowledgeable player after a loss, losing is a mechanic and the game was designed around it.

-The exploration of everything
A game is not just something about achievements, numbers and values, i think your personal experience of it counts as the most important factor of all. That being said, i have some great moments with this game, for example: When i first got to a certain level of the camp, there was a little guy that would pick up coins on the ground and would not give it back. I would be very confused and mad at this behavior, so i made up a plan to try and murder him, so maybe i can get my coins back. I made a trail of coins leading to one of the gates so the monsters would catch him, but he was immune to it so i felt like i had an immortal parasite living in my kingdom. Obviously he was not and is in fact a very helpful npc, but just look at how natural all of this felt, just a person trying to figure something out on it's own and having it's funny moments. If i was this mad at the coin collector npc (which i called thief) for not giving my coins back, don't even get me started on the knights...
The exploration part of the game is well-built and for the most part, very clear. If a statue has an archer in it, obviously it benefits archers.

-Lore?
Games that express themselves the non-verbal way, will always tickle something in the brain of a naturally curious human being, even if there's no meaning behind it, really. Why is the king/queen is so sacred that others sacrifice themselves and apparently get left behind because saving it is just so much more important? What are the monsters really? It's fun making up stuff using your mind.

-Graphics
The pixelated look of the game is really well done and the artist knew how to do a lot by using very little. The mount looks and animations are incredible. No perfomance issues on all devices i tried. Good water.

Улучшенная и доработанная Kingdom Сlassic: новые животные, статуи и помощники, механика с островами и совершенно чарующая смена времен года (не ожидала, что в пиксельной игре можно наслаждаться подобным). За 55 рублей на распродаже брать обязательно (65, если хотите музыку).
Что надо знать перед покупкой:
1. Это стратегия, где слово твое закон, и отменить его нельзя. Сказал работяге идти в ночь валить лес - он и пойдет. И дебил там не он, настоящий дебил в этот момент кричит "ну и куда ты?!" XD Готовиться надо ко всему: к ночи, к зиме, к заплыву на другой остров... 
И да, если ваш рабочий настойчиво рвется в ночи в лес - это он не погулять решил, это кое-кто баловался деньгами и пометил дерево для сруба XD Я из-за этого баловства умерла на Острове Черепа. 
2. Это игра рассчитана на вдумчивое изучение, на то, что вам будет в кайф плавать среди островов и открывать новые возможности. Если душа требует один раз пронестись ураганом по островам, всех убить на Острове черепа и таким образом закончить игру - лучше пройти мимо. 
3. Настоящий король данной игры - рандооооом! xD Если не повезло с бафами на острове, до свиданья, начинаем заплыв заново! Мне так не повезло на 3 острове: торговец с деньгами не появился, да еще и кролики прекратили плодиться, хотя еще даже осень не пришла. Я впрыгивала в корабль, убегая от толпы врагов, которые в ту кровавую ночь снесли все стены в королевстве и улюлюкая, гнались за мной xD

Если это все не проблема, то игра дико затягивает. Для меня самое кайфовое было играть в догонялки: приплыть на остров, разведать его, отстроить корабль и уплыть до того, как все станет по-настоящему плохо. И так по кругу по всем островам, пока не открыла все улучшения.

📖 HISTÓRIA E NARRATIVA

Não tem história. Literalmente não tem nada. Você inicia do nada, joga, passa de ilha em ilha e finaliza do nada após destruir todos os portais. A ausência de narrativa é total, focando apenas na mecânica de sobrevivência e progressão.

══════════════════════════════════════════

⚙️ DESEMPENHO E ESTABILIDADE

O jogo é super leve e compatível com praticamente qualquer PC. Roda sem problemas mesmo em máquinas mais modestas.

总体体验是差的，不建议玩，且后期发育时间太漫长，游玩体验过程中，能感觉到很多“设计难受”的地方。

首先，在喷之前，先说优点
优：
1、关卡继承设计和玩法不错
上一关的骑士射手继承机制：可以通过船只到达港口后在边缘的城区“出击”，达到将上一关的骑士和射手工匠带到下一关的设定

傻逼的地方：
1、坐骑没有“保底概率”，我从第一关玩到底五关，其中还回到过一次第一个和第三关，也就是我打了5次有坐骑的关卡，但是没有遇到一次坐骑，作者真是无敌了，作者小时候巴士没有保底概率，所以都是走三百六十五里路去上学的吗？
2、工匠的傻逼优先级
砍树优先级＞建设边防，只要你在怪物巢穴附近设置了砍树（要素①），再加上破坏怪物巢穴后的怪物潮（要素②），你就会得到一直死的工匠和一直来不及建设的边防，以及能看到却看不掉的树，还有永远达不到边防的投石车，你无敌了作者
3、懦夫骑士
在城墙还有半血左右，骑士就会逃跑，而不是保护弓箭手后撤到下一个边防，懦弱之举我决不姑息
4、傻子工程师
在我游玩过程中，工程师到达新地图后，不会在我们建立主城后“主动”进入主城内，
这里有个惯性思维诱导，在携带工程师到达新地图后，弓弩手和骑士工匠，都会主动往主城方向接近，【即便主城还没有建立】
如果你喜欢在游玩后期关卡的时候，努力搭建边防然后造弩箭塔，花了两个小时，最后发现工程师早就被怪物抱走了，然后血怒，这个游戏会很适合你
5、部分地图设计很蠢
比如前几关，主城门口就是难民地，导致亏损打猎收益（不过这还可以接受，发育几天，攒够了人口就可以）
连续的土堆太少了

最后，这是个傻逼游戏。
我也是个傻逼，在通过了《kingdom：classic》且看了“不建议玩《kingdom：newland》”的评价后，还是选择相信作者，玩了48个小时（加上小号），这太tm蠢了，简直是浪费时间
